_doc: S8-014: advisories that do not block CI. Each needs the reason it does not apply, an owner and a review date within 90 days. Reviewed at every release audit.

allow.reason: picomatch <=4.0.7 ReDoS (single-branch repeated extglobs); no patched release exists (4.0.7 is the latest). Reached only through build and dev tooling (vite, tinyglobby, fdir, @tailwindcss/cli, @parcel/watcher, typescript-eslint). It matches glob patterns written in the repo's own config, never visitor input, and is not shipped to the site. npm's only offered fix downgrades vite 8 to 6.2.7. Owner decision 2026-11-18: allowlist for 30 days, drop when picomatch is patched.
